note: Measured MHS3 face rulebook for the VRoid-based head (Sammy 2026-10-18: 'establish rules as to per acceptable dimensions for the head and elements ... the shader must always match the mhs3 shader. Validation is always strictly necessary ... extremely strict'). Every rule has a measured target, a tolerance and its source. A version passes only when EVERY rule is within tolerance (err_tol <= 1.0) and the TypeSafe rules clear their thresholds. Run blender/head_vroid/mhs3_validate.py; skill mhs3-master-loop.

units.D: pupil line to chin bottom (front), mesh or pupil-aligned render
units.H: skull top (highest skin vertex) to chin bottom - the dataset's unit (knowledge/head-targets-dataset.json)
units.IPD: pupil distance of the aligned reference (render rules)
units.behind_tip: how far a midline profile point sits behind the nose tip (pure side view)

sources.leo_front: docs/qa/head_v2/judge/leo_ref_front.png (MHST3-Leo_Render_001, front, neutral) - p-series measurements in D (docs/qa/newhead/visual_judge_log.md) and mhs3_render_measure.py
sources.mhs3_04: docs/reference/mhs3/profile/face_profile_04.png (crop of 04-egg-lantern.jpg, ~70 deg near-profile), landmarks hand-read on a 1 px grid (q36), +-0.02 D
sources.dataset: knowledge/head-targets-dataset.json behind_nose bands, 18 visually verified anime heads (median, p10-p90)
sources.sammy: Sammy's own picks (override books and MHS3): q34b eyes a bit bigger, not smaller, never a glare; q35 no egyptian / elongated eyes, fuller mouth, wider nose, neat (non-rubbery) shading; q36 features not too forward in profile

pass.regression_vs_last_approved: no rule may get worse by more than 0.25 tol

typesafe.note: TypeSafe jev-1.14 with images, both orders. Thresholds are CALIBRATED on real MHS3 faces judged the same way (Leia, Eleanor vs Leo, q36): a 'max' statement must be <= the worst MHS3 control + 0.03, a 'min' statement >= the weakest control - 0.05. A threshold MHS3 itself cannot meet is not a standard. defects_profile has no profile control yet: its thresholds stay provisional (0.45 / 0.55) until a second MHS3 profile is measured.

shader.note: Locked render spec (vroid_toon.MHS3_SPEC). Judging renders always use it; tune the model, not the light. Change the spec only through the shader rules S1-S7 and record the change here.
style: two tones only on skin (lit, shadow), hard terminator, no gradients baked in the texture
three skin tones like Leo: lit, cel shadow (~0.80 of lit), a deep core tone (~0.57) along the jaw side; tints are linear (sRGB ratio ** 2.2)
shadow is warm (red ratio above green/blue)
one clean shadow shape per form, no blotches (ellipsoid-blended normals)
flat lit skin, painted details only: nose wedge, under-lip, lid shade

lessons: Measure in D/H/IPD units only; pixel comparisons between different renders are meaningless.
Keep the warp identity through the eyes: depth remaps stretched the iris (m14 keyhole pupil); lid offsets must skip EyeIris/EyeHighlight.
Paint the iris in 3D (UV iris distorted); highlights stay in UV (3D fell off the quads).
Erase VRoid's own mouth line and darken the mouth interior (pink slivers in the seam).
Flat skin texture (mf=1.0) - VRoid gradients and the bandage made the shading rubbery.
Ellipsoid face normals w 0.95 - smoothed proxies gave blotchy shadows.
Small hooded eyes read evil (q34b): never shrink the eye opening below the Leo size; never a raised lower lid glare.
No lash tail past the outer corner, outer half pulled in (q35 'egyptian eyes').
q34 nose_lift + chin_fwd pushed the nose 0.07 H ahead of the forehead (m26): the profile rules P1-P8 now catch it.
TypeSafe A/B has a position bias: always ask both orders.
One warp field for every mesh so the seams stay closed.
q36: the face-mesh eye-hole boundary is NOT the visible lid edge - the lid's inner skin shows as a band under the lash; place the lash by the render rule E1, not by mesh alignment.
q36: mesh and render chin differ (render = outline top): compare like with like (F1 mesh vs R9 render), never mix.
q36: every warp gated by skin depth (y > ...) must move the mouth interior with the skin, or it pokes through (grey patches).

q36: EEVEE sun cast shadows rendered as speckled grey patches (nose shadow on the philtrum, lip shadow on the chin, faceted neck) - TypeSafe artifacts 0.93. Cast shadows off; MHS3 cast shadows are clean painted shapes (future: paint them).

eye_shape_template.note: Leo (mean of both eyes), opening outline inner->outer at 9 fractions of its width, edge height from the opening centre in units of its width (+ = down). Sammy q36: eye shape matching MHS3 is a standard.
